AT THE ENTRANCE WERE MIKA AND A MAN WHO LOOKED LIKE HE WAS TOSHIRO. WHEN MIKA SAW ME COME ROLLING OUT, SHE CAME RUNNING TOWARD ME. I SHUDDERED AT THE FURY ON HER FACE.
WHEN I CAME TO, MIKA WAS BEING RESTRAINED BY THAT MAN. SHE STRUGGLED DESPERATELY TO BREAK FREE FROM TOSHIRO, BUT SHE WAS NO MATCH FOR HIS STRENGTH.
SEEING MY BEST FRIEND LIKE THIS, I STARTED TO CRY.
AFTER SEVERAL WEEKS, I HAD RETURNED TO THE BUILDING.
AFTER THAT, I LEARNED EVERYTHING.
THE ONE WHO HAD BEEN BLASTING THE STEREO WAS NAOYA. I HAD TOLD TOSHIRO ABOUT THIS, SINCE WE HAD BEEN EXCHANGING LETTERS.
TOSHIRO WARNED NAOYA TO STOP PLAYING THE STEREO. NAOYA REALIZED HE WAS BOTHERING THE NEIGHBORS, AND RIGHT AWAY STOPPED PLAYING IT AT DAWN.
BUT MIKA HAD BEEN SECRETLY READING ALL OUR LETTERS.
MIKA HADN'T LIKED THAT I HAD ACTED ON MY OWN INSTEAD OF DEPENDING ON HER.
SO SHE THOUGHT OF PUNISHING ME. MAKING IT LOOK LIKE A NEIGHBOR'S DOING, SHE KEPT UP SEVERAL KINDS OF HARASSMENT.
AND SHE TRIED TO HURT ME... BUT TOSHIRO STOPPED HER.
DIFFICULT DAYS CONTINUED, BOTH MENTALLY AND PHYSICALLY.
IN THE MIDST OF ALL THAT, THE ONES WHO SUPPORTED ME WERE TOSHIRO AND NAOYA.
FUMINA-SAN, WHAT SHOULD I DO WITH THIS PACKAGE? THE ONE WHO ASKED ME THAT WAS TOSHIRO, CARRYING A CARDBOARD BOX IN HIS ARMS.
THANKS, HE SAID, AND TAKING THE CARDBOARD BOX HE LOADED IT ONTO THE TRUCK.
TODAY IS MOVING DAY. I COULDN'T KEEP LIVING IN A ROOM WHERE SUCH AN INCIDENT HAD HAPPENED. THOUGH I'M MOVING TO A WOMEN-ONLY BUILDING VERY CLOSE TO HERE......
SINCE I'LL STILL BE NEARBY, IF YOU HAVE TROUBLE JUST TELL ME, BOTH OF THEM SAID. MEETING THEM AND TALKING, THEY TURNED OUT TO BE GOOD PEOPLE.
I'M GLAD TO HAVE PEOPLE NEARBY I CAN TRUST. BUT I WON'T DEPEND ON THEM TOO MUCH. KNOWING THEY'RE CLOSE, I CAN DO ANYTHING ALONE.
I STAYED STILL INSIDE THE ROOM UNTIL THE POLICE ARRIVED.
NOTHING MORE COULD BE HEARD FROM THE ROOM NEXT DOOR. THE SILENCE WAS FRIGHTENING. THE POLICE STILL HADN'T ARRIVED...
AAAAAAAH...... SUDDENLY, A SHRILL SCREAM RANG OUT, AND I FROZE IN PLACE. THE SILENCE RETURNED.
IT CAN'T BE, IT CAN'T BE... A SUDDEN DOORBELL, DING DONG! I JUMPED AGAIN.
THEY FINALLY ARRIVED! I RUSHED TO THE ENTRANCE AND OPENED THE DOOR. THERE STOOD TWO UNIFORMED POLICE OFFICERS WITH STERN EXPRESSIONS. YOU'RE THE ONE WHO FILED THE REPORT, CORRECT?
IT'S NEXT DOOR, MIKA-CHAN IS NEXT DOOR... I POINTED AT THE NEIGHBORING ROOM, VOICE TREMBLING. THE OFFICERS LOOKED AT EACH OTHER, HEADED THERE, AND I FOLLOWED.
KUBO-SAN, THIS IS THE POLICE. WE'D LIKE A WORD... THE OFFICER KNOCKED, BUT NO ONE ANSWERED. THE OFFICERS EXCHANGED LOOKS, AND THEN...
CLICK, AND FINALLY THE DOOR OPENED, AND FOR THE FIRST TIME THE NEIGHBOR SHOWED HIS FACE. ARE YOU KUBO TOSHIRO-SAN? YES. WE'D LIKE TO TALK FOR A MOMENT...
SUDDENLY, THE STEREO STARTED BLASTING SO LOUD IT HURT THE EARS. EVERYONE JUMPED. THE OFFICER COVERED HIS EARS AND SHOUTED: I-IT'S THE STEREO!
EVEN THOUGH I WAS ALREADY USED TO HEARING IT, HEARING IT THIS CLOSE WAS OUTRAGEOUS. WHILE COVERING MY EARS, I NOTICED SOMETHING I RECOGNIZED AT THE MAN'S FEET... I KNEW IT!
HE WAS GIVING EXPLANATIONS TO THE POLICE, BUT I SLIPPED AWAY AND WENT INTO THE ROOM. WAIT, WAIT! THE MAN RAISED HIS VOICE TO STOP ME, BUT I IGNORED HIM AND KEPT GOING TOWARD THE BACK.
BEHIND ME I COULD HEAR THE MAN AND THE OFFICERS ARGUING. I WENT OPENING, ONE BY ONE, THE DOORS OF THE ROOM.
AND THEN I FOUND MIKA. COVERED IN BLOOD, LYING ON THE FLOOR. AAAAAAAH!
WHAT HAPPENED TO HIM?! KUBO-SAN?! SOMEBODY HELP ME, PLEASE! I CRAWLED DESPERATELY TO THE DOOR, AND MANAGED TO UNLOCK IT WITH MY HANDS TIED BEHIND ME, TUMBLING OUT ROLLING.
INSIDE THE ROOM, THE MAN WAS ALONE, CLINGING TO HIS FORMER BEST FRIEND, BROKEN DOWN IN TEARS.
MONTHS PASSED. THE EXPERIENCE I'D LIVED HERE WAS SOMETHING I'D NEVER FORGET. WHAT I HAD GAINED WAS TOO GREAT. MY EYES FILLED WITH TEARS, AND I TOOK A STEP FORWARD.
IS THERE ANYTHING ELSE LEFT TO LOAD? TOSHIRO ASKED ME. NO, THERE'S NOTHING LEFT. THE TRUCK PULLED AWAY TOWARD THE NEW BUILDING.
WITHOUT REALIZING IT, I TURNED AROUND. IN THE GLASS THERE WAS......
